meta.title: What's New in Deadlock Mod Manager V2
meta.description: Deadlock Mod Manager V2, rebuilt from the ground up: mod health checks that repair outdated mods, mods that survive game updates, a GameBanana catalog that lives on your PC, conflict detection, a crash check, a broken-mod finder, stats and new themes.

hero.title: Rebuilt from the ground up
hero.intro: V2 repairs mods that a game update broke and warns you when two of them change the same files. If the game crashes on launch, it shows you what changed. The Mods Store now searches a copy of GameBanana on your PC.

updates.title: Your mods survive patch day
updates.body: While the app is open, it notices when a Steam update or another tool rewrites gameinfo.gi, tells you how many enabled mods stopped loading, and re-applies them in one click.

points.layout: A new addon folder layout lifts the old 99-file limit
points.patchNotes: Valve's latest patch notes on your Dashboard
points.inGame: Mod changes are blocked while Deadlock is running, unless you turn that off
points.vanilla: Optional: go back to vanilla when the game closes, so launching from Steam starts it without mods

health.title: Bring old mods back to life
health.body: Every Deadlock patch breaks some mods. V2 checks each mod you have installed against the game on your PC and repairs what it can verify for the current patch, including mods that stopped working long ago. It never touches your mod files.

points.when: Runs after you install or change a mod and after every game update, for enabled and disabled mods
points.fix: Fix every mod from the banner in Mods Library, one from its page or right-click menu, or let launch fix them for you
points.undo: Fixes live in a separate layer, so Use original files puts any mod back the way its author released it
points.local: Everything runs on your PC, and your choices are saved per profile

camera.title: Camera and aim
camera.body: Moves the camera and aim points on older hero skins to where the current game expects them.

animations.title: Animations and movement
animations.body: Repairs animation bindings, so heroes don't slide, freeze or skip animations.

appearance.title: Colors and textures
appearance.body: Fixes materials that no longer match the game and show up as wrong colors.

model.title: Model
model.body: Points models to where the game looks for them now, so your skin shows instead of the default.

gameData.title: Abilities, stats and text
gameData.body: Merges ability, stat and text changes when several mods edit the same game data.

health.caveat: It can't catch every problem. Mods with custom rigs or custom animations may still need an update from their author.

invite.title: Got a mod you gave up on?
invite.body: Install it and see what the check finds. If it still doesn't work after fixing, send it to us so we can teach the check to fix it.
invite.send: Send us a mod on Discord

store.title: The whole of GameBanana, on your PC
store.body: V2 keeps a copy of the GameBanana catalog on your PC, so browsing and searching don't wait on the network. It checks for new and updated mods when you start the app, then about every 30 minutes while it's open.

points.tabs: Separate tabs for Mods, Sounds, Collections and WiPs
points.pages: Mod pages with Overview, Changelog, Comments and Files tabs
points.authors: Author profiles with the mods each author has published
points.skip: Skip an update until the author publishes a newer one

store.alt: The Mods Store in Deadlock Mod Manager V2, showing a grid of GameBanana mods

groups.title: Sort your library into groups
groups.body: Put the mods in My Mods into groups, like the skins you main or the ones you're trying out. Each group shows covers of its mods and how many are on, and turns the whole set on or off in one click.

points.drag: Drag mods onto a group, or pick several and use Move to group
points.undo: Undo a move from the notification
points.profiles: Groups are saved per profile, and you can copy them to another profile
points.order: Groups only organize your library, so load order stays as it is

conflicts.title: Know when mods clash
conflicts.body: A Conflicts tab in My Mods shows which enabled mods change the same files, and which one the game uses.

points.loadFirst: Press Load first on the mod you want to see
points.hidden: A Model hidden badge on skins another mod covers up
points.ignore: Ignore overlaps you're happy with, per profile

crashes.title: Find out what broke the game
crashes.body: If Deadlock closes abnormally within five minutes of starting, the app asks whether it just crashed and lists everything that changed since your last normal session, with a way to undo each change.

points.changes: Covers new and updated mods, autoexec.cfg, launch options and files in your addons folder
points.undo: Disable the new mods, or open your autoexec and launch options, from the same dialog
points.build: Says so when Deadlock itself updated, since a patch can cause crashes on its own
points.steam: Works when you start the game from Steam too, as long as the app is open

bisect.title: Track down the mod that breaks the game
bisect.body: When something breaks and you can't tell which mod did it, the app turns your mods off in rounds. You launch, say whether the problem is still there, and each answer rules out a share of the rest.

points.fast: One bad mod takes at most 6 launches with 12 mods, and 9 with 100
points.pairs: Finds two mods that only break the game together
points.crash: With the crash check on, a crash answers the round for you
points.restore: Puts every mod back in its original load order when you're done, with the culprit off if you want

performance.title: More frames, your way
performance.body: Experimental: apply a community gameinfo.gi config that trades visual detail for frame rate, from barely touched to potato. The manager writes it next to your mods, puts it back after game updates, and turns it off cleanly when you're done. Turn it on in Settings → Experimental.

points.presets: Curated presets from Sqooky, dacooderr and others, plus configs from GameBanana
points.editor: Change any setting a config touches, with the game's default shown beside it
points.safe: Settings Deadlock no longer reads are left out, and you see why before anything is written
points.share: Import a pasted config, file or GameBanana link, and share yours as a code

performance.alt: The Performance page in Deadlock Mod Manager V2, with an applied config, the Looks best to Runs fastest scale and curated configs

themes.title: Make it yours
themes.body: V2 adds OLED, Lovelock and Gridline themes. Around five holidays a year, the app also switches to a seasonal theme with something hidden to find, unless you have picked a theme of your own.
themes.lovelockAlt: Deadlock Mod Manager with the Lovelock theme: plum and pink, with hero art behind the dashboard

halloween.name: Halloween
halloween.description: Pumpkin orange on midnight purple, a full moon, drifting fog, rising embers and the odd colony of bats.

christmas.name: Christmas
christmas.description: Firelight, cinnamon and candle gold under softly falling snow, with an advent calendar and treats hidden around the app.

newYear.name: New Year's Eve
newYear.description: Midnight blue and champagne gold with fireworks over the skyline and a live countdown to midnight.

lunarNewYear.name: Lunar New Year
lunarNewYear.window: Three weeks before Lunar New Year until the Lantern Festival
lunarNewYear.description: Lacquer red and gold with paper lanterns rising into the night and red envelopes to catch, through to the Lantern Festival.

easter.name: Easter
easter.window: 30 days before Easter Sunday until Easter Monday
easter.description: A spring meadow at dusk: chick yellow, blossom pink and fresh green, petals in the air and eggs hidden around the screen.

health.banner_one: Deadlock updated. {{count}} of your mods was made for an older version and can be fixed automatically.
health.banner_other: Deadlock updated. {{count}} of your mods were made for an older version and can be fixed automatically.
health.fixableSummary: Made for an older Deadlock version. These parts can be fixed automatically.
health.fixedSummary: Made for an older Deadlock version. These parts were fixed for this patch.

update.title: Deadlock updated and switched your mods off.
update.body: Steam replaced gameinfo.gi, so your 14 enabled mods won't load until they're re-applied.
update.reapplied: Mods re-applied. They'll load next time you start Deadlock.

groups.hint: Try it: press the power button on a group.

crash.title: Did Deadlock just crash?
crash.body: It closed 1 minute after starting and left a crash report. One of these recent changes may be the cause.
crash.changesHeading: Changed since your last normal session
crash.modsAdded: 2 mods added: Formal Wraith and Vyper Propeller Hat
crash.tip: Change one thing at a time and launch again. That's the quickest way to find what's causing it.

bisect.title: Finding the broken mod
bisect.question: Is the problem still there?
bisect.foundBody: The problem comes and goes with this mod.
bisect.wrongAnswer: One of your answers didn't match the game, so this isn't the real culprit. Try again.
bisect.restored: Your mods are back the way they were.
bisect.hint: Try it: launch, look at the game, then answer.
bisect.foundHint: Try again hides the problem in a different mod.

foundry.title: Mod Foundry
foundry.body: Import a hero skin, recolor it, swap its cards and sounds, and export it as a mod.

stats.title: Stats
stats.body: Hero, item and teammate breakdowns, match history with item timelines, and live ranks for your current match (with the -condebug launch option). Rearrange, resize, add or remove widgets and tabs, and filter by ranked, unranked or a start date.

skins.title: Hero Skins
skins.body: Every skin for a hero on one page, with a 3D preview. With the skin randomizer on, each launch picks a random skin from the ones you chose.

library.title: Library sorting
library.body: Sort My Mods by install order, hero, name or when you added them.

launch.title: Launch progress
launch.body: See each step while Deadlock starts, from verifying your mods to opening Steam, and cancel the launch if you change your mind.

badges.title: Update badges
badges.body: Update available and recently updated badges on mod cards and details, now on disabled mods too.

import.title: Coming from Grimoire?
import.body: Import its mods, profiles and crosshairs, or any mod-interchange file. Export works too.

updates.title: Mod updates
updates.body: Read a GameBanana mod's changelog before updating, and watch the download progress.

settings.title: Settings search
settings.body: Find any setting from the search box in the settings sidebar.

heroes.title: New heroes
heroes.body: Baba, Deadman Danny, Nurse Harrow, Rat King, Solomon and Violet are now recognized.

forge.title: 1-click installs
forge.body: Opt in to install mods straight from DeadlockForge. Each install asks first.

servers.title: Server Browser
servers.body: Browse Deadworks community servers and get their maps and addons before you join.

install.title: Install V2 like any update
install.body: Your mods, profiles and settings carry over.

migrate.title: Profiles move to the new layout
migrate.body: The first time you use a profile, its mods move to the new addon folder layout by themselves.

help.title: Something look off?
help.body: In Settings → Tools, Repair mod folder sets aside files the app didn't install and rebuilds its list of your mods without deleting anything. Diagnose connection checks every service the app relies on. If the app and your game folder are still out of sync, Nuke & Reinstall wipes your mods and downloads them again. Still stuck? Ask on <discord>Discord</discord>.

fixes.label: Bugs squashed since V1
fixes.body: Fix commits to the app since V1. The ones that made the release notes are listed here, and <link>the full changelog</link> has everything else.

thanks.title: Thank you
thanks.body: To the 20,000+ members of our <discord>Discord</discord>, for every bug report and suggestion.
